title: Harmony
extract:
Harmony is  Jade's signature scythe and counterpart to Stalker's  Hate. Heavy Attacks detonate damage over time Status Effects to instantly inflict their full damage, while Heavy Attack kills grant Status Duration.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Reaping Spiral and  Shadow Harvest (Conclave only) stance.
Enemies hit by Heavy Attacks while debuffed with active  Slash,  Heat,  Toxin,  Electricity, and  Gas Status Effects will instantly receive the full damage from all damage ticks of the procs; status effects are removed after inflicting damage.
Effect also applies to procs generated by the Heavy Attack itself.
Heavy Attack kills grant Harmonic Resonance, increasing Status Duration by 30% for 30 seconds to all allies within Affinity Range.
When combined with the effects of  Evensong, and  Cantare, all three buffs merge into Jade's Ensemble, which lasts 60 seconds and increases the Status Duration bonus to 60%.
Does not affect Companions.

Acquisition
Harmony's blueprint is obtained from Ascension on Brutus, Uranus, at a 5% drop rate.
Alternatively, the blueprint can also be purchased from Ordis in the Drifter's Camp for 300  Vestigial Motes, awarded from Ascension in quantities of 11-13 (16-18 on The Steel Path) from mission completion and 5-7 (8-10 on The Steel Path) from the optional Sisters of Parvos objective.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Harmony "detonates" status procs immediately after it does damage, including any procs caused by the heavy attack itself hitting.
Harmonic Resonance is a universal status duration buff that also applies to warframe and companion abilities.

Tips
Adding Status Duration will increase damage dealt on heavy attacks due to increasing how much total damage is condensed into a single hit.
 Ash and  Saryn will deal increased damage on heavy attacks by default, as their passives grant  Slash/Status duration boosts respectively.
 Citrine's  Prismatic Gem will massively increase Status Duration.
 Lavos can increase Status Duration on his weapons via Ability Duration.
 Garuda's  Seeking Talons causes a multitude of  Slash procs for Harmony to utilize.
 Koumei's  Kumihimo and  Bunraku can inflict several different procs in an area, though this includes non-damaging ones.
 Melee Influence and  Melee Afflictions can spread a lot of damaging status effects very quickly.
Tennokai can be used to first prime enemies with status effects, then detonate those and apply + detonate the slash proc from the heavy attack without spending your combo.
